import numpy as np
def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    r=1-np.sum((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2)
    return r,dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4)))
